wrong_fix_reverted.what_was_rewritten_instead_of_deleted: TWO things were deliberately KEPT/REWRITTEN rather than reverted. (a) The message.audio branch that 8f9e46e ADDED to handleMessage is structurally useful and is KEPT: before it, a bare (non-reply) audio fell through to showHome SILENTLY, which is a genuine defect independent of the reply-vs-bare-send question. Only its reply-only guidance text was reverted; it now reads 'This audio file was not expected. Open Settings -> Music library and tap Add music files, then send or forward the tracks.' (b) bot/test/flow-forward-regression.test.mjs was REWRITTEN, not deleted: its 5 tests pinned the WRONG (reply-only) behavior, so the copy assertions are inverted to pin the RESTORED send-or-forward copy, and the file grew to 6 tests. While rewriting, a real HARNESS BUG in the 8f9e46e version was found and fixed: its genuine-reply test ('a .torrent REPLY ... routes to the wizard') seeded NO credentials, so handleTorrentDocument's requireCredentials() returned falsy, handleFlowReply returned undefined, and the message actually fell through to the reject branch — the test passed only vacuously because the OLD reject copy happened not to contain the string 'not expected' that it asserted against. It never verified reply routing at all. The rewritten harness seeds credentials via putCredentials (as tasks.test.mjs does) and stubs the Telegram getFile/file-download and the GitHub contents PUT, so the reply path is now genuinely exercised end to end and a second genuine-reply test (text/link reply) was added alongside it.

design_confirmation.write_frequency_reasoning: CONFIRMED SAFE. The kv-minimization migration removed the legacy per-chat state blob because it was rewritten on EVERY navigation event (menus, wizards, per-keystroke-equivalent updates). The awaiting_input marker is written ONLY when the bot sends a force_reply/flow-marker prompt: one INSERT OR REPLACE per prompt-sent (a user-initiated step transition), one SELECT per bare non-command message, and one conditional DELETE per consumed marker. Prompt sends are a strict subset of the old navigation writes (menus never write awaiting_input at all), and there is no per-message write path — bare input messages only read. Volume is bounded at one write per input step per chat, far below the removed blob's write rate.
design_confirmation.precedence_rule_implemented: PENDING implementation in step 3; rule decided: parseFlowReply (the genuine reply_to_message edge) is checked FIRST and wins whenever present; awaiting_input is consulted ONLY when parseFlowReply returns null. Stated here so the step-3 implementation is unambiguous.

bot/src/index.js and bot/src/github.js contain a literal control character inside a regex literal (SAFE_AUDIO_FILENAME_RE), which makes git and grep treat them as binary. Diffs for these files show as 'Bin ... bytes differ'. Use `grep --text`. Not introduced by this session; flagged because it makes review of index.js changes harder.
